agent_events_report_window.name: agent_events_report_window
agent_events_report_window.where: data->>'report' is not null or data->>'from' = 'agent'

machines_role.name: machines_role
machines_role.value: role IS NULL OR role IN ('data', 'worker')

machines_path.name: machines_path
machines_path.value: path IS NULL OR path IN ('direct', 'relay')

machines_update_state.name: machines_update_state
machines_update_state.value: update_state IS NULL OR update_state IN ('ready', 'installing', 'failed')

machines_server_pin_value.name: machines_server_pin_value
machines_server_pin_value.value: server_pin = 'none' OR CASE WHEN server_pin ~ '^[1-9][0-9]{0,2}$' THEN server_pin::int >= 2 ELSE false END

machines_copy_state.name: machines_copy_state
machines_copy_state.value: copy_state IS NULL OR copy_state IN ('making', 'remaking', 'ready', 'stopped', 'saving')

machines_copy_error.name: machines_copy_error
machines_copy_error.value: copy_error IS NULL OR copy_error IN ('disk_full', 'apply', 'led', 'setup')

machines_upload_state.name: machines_upload_state
machines_upload_state.value: upload_state IS NULL OR upload_state IN ('waiting', 'received', 'kept')

machines_measures_range.name: machines_measures_range
machines_measures_range.value: link_rtt_ms >= 0 AND link_mbps >= 0 AND internet_rtt_ms >= 0 AND internet_mbps >= 0

map_returns_given_back.name: map_returns_given_back
map_returns_given_back.value: ("map_returns"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("map_returns"."returned_epoch" IS NULL) AND ("map_returns"."returned_at" IS NULL) = ("map_returns"."source_key" IS NULL)

model_check_certificates_end.name: model_check_certificates_end
model_check_certificates_end.value: ("model_check_certificates"."status" = 'invalidated') = ("model_check_certificates"."invalidated_reason" IS NOT NULL) AND ("model_check_certificates"."status" = 'invalidated') = ("model_check_certificates"."invalidated_at" IS NOT NULL)

model_check_evaluations_clean_pass.name: model_check_evaluations_clean_pass
model_check_evaluations_clean_pass.value: "model_check_evaluations"."status" <> 'passed' OR ("model_check_evaluations"."complete" AND "model_check_evaluations"."infra_errors" = 0 AND "model_check_evaluations"."must_block_misses" = 0 AND "model_check_evaluations"."metrics" IS NOT NULL AND "model_check_evaluations"."holdout_metrics" IS NOT NULL)

model_checks_on_is_bound.name: model_checks_on_is_bound
model_checks_on_is_bound.value: "model_checks"."status" = 'off' OR ("model_checks"."binding_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "model_checks"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL AND "model_checks"."thresholds" IS NOT NULL AND "model_checks"."off_reason" IS NULL)

outbound_approvals_kind.name: outbound_approvals_kind
outbound_approvals_kind.value:
CASE "outbound_approvals"."kind"
    WHEN 'message' THEN "outbound_approvals"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."message_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."content_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."binding_generation" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."channel_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."template_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."template_revision" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."segment_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."locale" IS NULL
    WHEN 'approach' THEN "outbound_approvals"."channel_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."template_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."template_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."segment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."locale" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."message_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."message_revision" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."content_digest" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."account_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_approvals"."binding_generation" IS NULL
    ELSE false END

outbound_attempts_outcome.name: outbound_attempts_outcome
outbound_attempts_outcome.value:
CASE "outbound_attempts"."status"
    WHEN 'accepted' THEN "outbound_attempts"."provider_receipt" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."safe_code" IS NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'definitely_not_accepted' THEN "outbound_attempts"."safe_code" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."provider_receipt" IS NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
    WHEN 'unknown' THEN "outbound_attempts"."safe_code" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."provider_receipt" IS NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL
    ELSE "outbound_attempts"."safe_code" IS NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."provider_receipt" IS NULL AND "outbound_attempts"."ended_at" IS NULL END

outbound_catalog_published.name: outbound_catalog_published
outbound_catalog_published.value: ("outbound_catalog_revisions"."status" = 'proposed') = ("outbound_catalog_revisions"."published_by" IS NULL) AND ("outbound_catalog_revisions"."published_by" IS NULL) = ("outbound_catalog_revisions"."published_at" IS NULL)

outbound_channels_stop.name: outbound_channels_stop
outbound_channels_stop.value: ("outbound_channels"."status" = 'stopped') = ("outbound_channels"."stopped_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("outbound_channels"."status" = 'stopped') = ("outbound_channels"."stopped_reason" IS NOT NULL)

outbound_messages_target.name: outbound_messages_target
outbound_messages_target.value:
CASE "outbound_messages"."target_kind"
    WHEN 'contact' THEN "outbound_messages"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."segment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."audience_entry_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."ticket_revision" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."classification_id" IS NULL
    WHEN 'audience' THEN "outbound_messages"."audience_entry_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."segment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."contact_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."ticket_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."ticket_revision" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."classification_id" IS NULL
    WHEN 'ticket' THEN "outbound_messages"."contact_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."ticket_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."ticket_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."classification_id" IS NOT NULL AND "outbound_messages"."segment_id" IS NULL AND "outbound_messages"."audience_entry_id" IS NULL
    ELSE false END

people_assistant.name: people_assistant
people_assistant.value: ("people"."is_agent" AND "people"."assistant_of" IS NOT NULL AND "people"."password_hash" IS NULL) OR (NOT "people"."is_agent" AND "people"."assistant_of" IS NULL AND "people"."email" IS NOT NULL)

proposals_material_stamp.name: proposals_material_stamp
proposals_material_stamp.value:
("proposals"."material_revision" IS NULL AND "proposals"."material_digest" IS NULL) OR
  ("proposals"."material_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."material_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "proposals"."material_revision" > 0
   AND "proposals"."material_revision" <= 9007199254740991 AND "proposals"."material_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

request_internal_resolver_whole.name: request_internal_resolver_whole
request_internal_resolver_whole.value:
num_nonnulls("request_internal"."resolved_by_agent_id", "request_internal"."resolved_by_job_id", "request_internal"."resolved_at") IN (0, 3)
    AND ("request_internal"."resolved_source_sequence" IS NULL OR "request_internal"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

requests_material_stamp.name: requests_material_stamp
requests_material_stamp.value:
("requests"."material_revision" IS NULL AND "requests"."material_digest" IS NULL) OR
  ("requests"."material_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."material_digest" IS NOT NULL AND "requests"."material_revision" > 0
   AND "requests"."material_revision" <= 9007199254740991 AND "requests"."material_digest" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

requests_approval_commit.name: requests_approval_commit
requests_approval_commit.value: "requests"."kind" <> 'approval' OR "requests"."commit" IS NOT NULL OR "requests"."approval_channel" IS NOT NULL

support_classifications_decision.name: support_classifications_decision
support_classifications_decision.value:
CASE "support_classifications"."status"
    WHEN 'pending' THEN "support_classifications"."class_id" IS NULL AND "support_classifications"."requires_human" IS NULL AND "support_classifications"."reviewer" IS NULL AND "support_classifications"."decided_at" IS NULL
    WHEN 'ready' THEN "support_classifications"."class_id" IS NOT NULL AND "support_classifications"."requires_human" IS NOT NULL AND "support_classifications"."reviewer" IS NOT NULL AND "support_classifications"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL
    ELSE "support_classifications"."class_id" IS NULL AND "support_classifications"."requires_human" IS NULL AND "support_classifications"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL END

task_waits_counts.name: task_waits_counts
task_waits_counts.value: "task_waits"."source_revision" >= 0 AND "task_waits"."generation" >= 1 AND "task_waits"."review_ordinal" >= 0 AND "task_waits"."route_revision" >= 0 AND "task_waits"."level" BETWEEN 0 AND 3

task_waits_active_is_whole.name: task_waits_active_is_whole
task_waits_active_is_whole.value:
"task_waits"."state" <> 'active' OR (
    ("task_waits"."owner_agent_id" IS NULL) <> ("task_waits"."owner_person_id" IS NULL) AND "task_waits"."plan" IS NOT NULL AND "task_waits"."owner_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_waits"."head_due_at" IS NOT NULL
    AND "task_waits"."decision_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "task_waits"."next_action_at" IS NOT NULL)

task_waits_reviews_go_on.name: task_waits_reviews_go_on
task_waits_reviews_go_on.value: "task_waits"."state" <> 'active' OR "task_waits"."next_review_at" IS NOT NULL OR ("task_waits"."review_ordinal" >= 1 AND "task_waits"."kind" = 'external' AND "task_waits"."source_key" LIKE 'operation:%')

task_waits_legacy_has_no_dates.name: task_waits_legacy_has_no_dates
task_waits_legacy_has_no_dates.value: "task_waits"."state" <> 'legacy_needs_plan' OR ("task_waits"."plan" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."owner_due_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."head_due_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."decision_due_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."next_action_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."next_review_at" IS NULL)

task_waits_ended.name: task_waits_ended
task_waits_ended.value: ("task_waits"."state" IN ('active', 'legacy_needs_plan')) = ("task_waits"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."outcome" IS NULL AND "task_waits"."proof_ref" IS NULL)

tasks_closed_at.name: tasks_closed_at
tasks_closed_at.value: "tasks"."status" NOT IN ('done', 'cancelled') OR "tasks"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL

test_runs_environment_request.name: test_runs_environment_request
test_runs_environment_request.where: "test_runs"."environment_request" is not null and "test_runs"."environment_snapshot" is null and "test_runs"."status" = 'running'

turn_tokens_counts.name: turn_tokens_counts
turn_tokens_counts.value: coalesce("turn_tokens"."input_tokens", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("turn_tokens"."output_tokens", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("turn_tokens"."cache_read_tokens", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("turn_tokens"."cache_write_tokens", 0) >= 0 and coalesce("turn_tokens"."total_tokens", 0) >= 0

wait_notices_cards.name: wait_notices_cards
wait_notices_cards.where: "wait_notices"."person_id" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."acknowledged_at" IS NULL

wait_notices_wait_whole.name: wait_notices_wait_whole
wait_notices_wait_whole.value: "wait_notices"."wait_id" IS NULL OR ("wait_notices"."generation" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."level" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."purpose" IS NOT NULL AND "wait_notices"."route_revision" IS NOT NULL)
